finalText: The build is clean now. The buried error was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of pulling it from the environment object that was passed in. Changed it to `env.retries || 1` to match what the build script expected. The three warnings that show up are all real but harmless — deprecated API usage, an unused export, and a circular dependency. Build now finishes with zero errors.
